statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
Prolonged ambulatory monitoring is indicated to correlate cardiac rhythm disturbances with neurological symptoms and dizziness
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was billed
The diagnosis codes I47.1, G45.9, and R42 were submitted
The service was denied under reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that this specific diagnostic procedure is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
